messages.content: can you tell me what has changed in brain app today in terms of features functionality bla bla bla, give me shortlist if you can

Here's what actually shipped to the CRS Brain app today (2026-07-16) — grouped, ignoring the auto-named chat-prompt commits:

**Buildprint chat — safety & capability**
- Hard safety gate on the Buildprint chat + readable bp responses (`a0e7ec7`)
- Enforce plan → (savepoint → apply → check) per-step loop (`f9c1613`)
- Gave the agent "eyes" — screenshots, browser checks, theme testing (`375e3af`)
- Sped it up — allow local Node/Python scripting (`10d0550`)
- Disabled Buildprint auto-sync (`bpAutoTrack: false`) (`8f62b22`)

**Safety / recovery**
- Action log + savepoint-based rollback (`063cd6c`)
- Persistent memory ("never-forget", always honored) (`1c11459`)

**Wishlist feature**
- Added Improvements Wishlist + session log (`234b2fa`)
- Task-loop auto-resume + auto-fix Bubble issues (`b693d34`)
- New standalone `wishlist.html` page (uncommitted, plus edits in flight)

**Chat/UI polish**
- Claude-style responses, Back button far left, file hover-download (`427e08b`)
- Modern readable chat tables (`3e77893`)
- Agent activity grouped into Buildprint-style "Worked for Xs" blocks (`161cf4e`)
- File viewer — Download + Back buttons (`1378414`)

**Prompt-generation system (new)**
- PROMPT-STANDARD.md + 4 templates (audit/edit/pilot/reply), wired into CLAUDE.md (`7f6e2ef`, `9dd7758`, `c7bc311`)

**Ingest**
- Fixed ingest to embed report content inline (stop the file-hunt) (`65287f1`)

**Still uncommitted right now:** `server.js`, `public/index.html`, `WISHLIST.md`, `decisions.md`, and a new `public/wishlist.html`.

Want me to look inside the uncommitted changes to tell you what's mid-flight?
